name: shop-pot
task: Whenever the pot boils over, turn the stove down.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a single 'whenever pot boils over, turn stove down' rule; Response(pot_boiling, stove_fixed) hard captures it correctly. The rule-only warning is valid since no goal is commanded.

texts: Whenever the pot boils over, the stove is turned down.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, pot_boiling&!stove_fixed) -> u1
(u1, stove_fixed) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, pot_boiling&!stove_fixed, u1) -> -1
(u1, stove_fixed, u0) -> 1
